statement.ru: Кофейные зёрна — это косточки ягод кофейного дерева.
statement.en: Coffee beans are the seeds of the coffee plant's berries.

why: True: the bean is the seed inside the coffee cherry.

statement.ru: Ройбуш — это сорт чёрного чая.
statement.en: Rooibos is a kind of black tea.

why: False: rooibos is Aspalathus linearis, a South African legume, not the tea plant.

statement.ru: В растениях кофеин работает как яд против насекомых.
statement.en: In plants, caffeine works as a poison against insects.

why: True: caffeine acts as a natural pesticide that can paralyse and kill insects feeding on the plant.

statement.ru: Чашка кофе отнимает у тела больше воды, чем даёт.
statement.en: A cup of coffee takes more water out of the body than it gives.

why: False: the NHS counts tea and coffee toward daily fluid intake; regular drinkers get no extra urine.

statement.ru: Название чая «улун» по-китайски значит «чёрный дракон».
statement.en: The name of oolong tea means 'black dragon' in Chinese.

why: True: wulong cha, 'black (dark) dragon tea'.

statement.ru: Плоды какао растут прямо на стволе дерева.
statement.en: Cacao pods grow right on the tree trunk.

why: True: cacao is cauliflorous, it flowers and fruits from its trunk.

statement.ru: Белый чай делают из лепестков белых цветов.
statement.en: White tea is made from the petals of white flowers.

why: False: white tea is young leaves and buds of the tea plant; the name is from the white hairs on the buds.

statement.ru: В банке «Ред Булла» вдвое больше кофеина, чем в чашке кофе.
statement.en: A can of Red Bull has twice the caffeine of a cup of coffee.

why: False: a 250 ml can has 40 to 80 mg, less than or about the same as a cup of coffee (about 80 to 125 mg).

statement.ru: В Париже XVII века лимонад разносили торговцы с баками за спиной.
statement.en: In 17th-century Paris, lemonade was sold by vendors with tanks on their backs.

why: True: Paris lemonade sellers (Compagnie de Limonadiers, 1676) carried tanks on their backs.

statement.ru: Кофеин полностью уходит из организма примерно за час.
statement.en: Caffeine completely leaves the body in about an hour.

why: False: its half-life in adults is 3 to 7 hours.

statement.ru: «Доктор Пеппер» появился раньше кока-колы.
statement.en: Dr Pepper appeared before Coca-Cola.

why: True: Dr Pepper was first sold in 1885, a year before Coca-Cola.

statement.ru: Кофе попал в Европу из Америки, как картошка и какао.
statement.en: Coffee reached Europe from the Americas, like potatoes and cocoa.

why: False: coffee came from Africa via Arabia and the Ottoman Empire; it was taken to the Americas later.

statement.ru: Больше всех в мире чая на человека пьют англичане.
statement.en: The British drink the most tea per person in the world.

why: False: Turkey is first (3.16 kg a year), then Ireland; the UK is fourth (1.82 kg).

statement.ru: В кока-коле когда-то был кокаин.
statement.en: Coca-Cola once contained cocaine.

why: True: early Coca-Cola held an estimated 9 mg of cocaine per glass; fresh coca leaf was dropped in 1903.

statement.ru: «Ред Булл» сделан по образцу тайского энергетика.
statement.en: Red Bull was modelled on a Thai energy drink.

why: True: it was derived from the Thai drink Krating Daeng.

statement.ru: Зуб, оставленный на ночь в газировке, растворится.
statement.en: A tooth left overnight in a fizzy drink will dissolve.

why: False: an urban myth from a misreported 1950 remark; acid wears enamel only slowly.

statement.ru: Таурин из энергетиков впервые нашли в бычьей желчи.
statement.en: Taurine, found in energy drinks, was first discovered in ox bile.

why: True: isolated from ox bile in 1827; the name is from Latin taurus, bull.

statement.ru: Морская вода утоляет жажду, если пить её маленькими глотками.
statement.en: Seawater quenches thirst if you drink it in small sips.

why: False: the body must pass more water to get rid of the salt than the seawater gives.

statement.ru: Апельсиновый сок «не из концентрата» могут хранить в цистернах до года.
statement.en: Not-from-concentrate orange juice can be kept in tanks for up to a year.

why: True: NFC juice may be stored chilled in aseptic tanks; storage may be up to a year because production is seasonal.

statement.ru: Козье молоко — безлактозное.
statement.en: Goat's milk is lactose-free.

why: False: goat's milk has about 4.7 % lactose, the same as cow's milk.

statement.ru: Грейпфрутовый сок может усилить действие некоторых лекарств.
statement.en: Grapefruit juice can boost the effect of some medicines.

why: True: it raises blood levels of some drugs, even to overdose.

statement.ru: В зёрнах арабики больше кофеина, чем в зёрнах робусты.
statement.en: Arabica beans have more caffeine than robusta beans.

why: False: arabica has 0.8 to 1.4 % caffeine, robusta 1.7 to 4 %.

statement.ru: Большинство взрослых на Земле плохо переваривают молочный сахар.
statement.en: Most adults on Earth digest milk sugar poorly.

why: True: about 65 % of adults worldwide have lactose malabsorption.

statement.ru: Пуэр — японский чай.
statement.en: Pu'er is a Japanese tea.

why: False: pu'er comes from Yunnan province, China, named after the town of Pu'er.

statement.ru: Первые «молочные коктейли» в XIX веке делали с виски.
statement.en: The first 'milkshakes', in the 19th century, were made with whiskey.

why: True: in 1885 a milkshake was an eggnog-like drink with eggs and whiskey.

statement.ru: «Гаторейд» придумали для астронавтов NASA.
statement.en: Gatorade was invented for NASA astronauts.

why: False: it was made in 1965 at the University of Florida for its football team, the Gators.

statement.ru: Миндальное молоко пили ещё в Средние века.
statement.en: People drank almond milk as far back as the Middle Ages.

why: True: it replaced animal milk on Catholic fast days in the Middle Ages.

statement.ru: Кофе без кофеина обычно делают из сорта, где кофеина нет от природы.
statement.en: Decaf coffee is usually made from a variety that has no caffeine by nature.

why: False: decaf is ordinary beans with the caffeine washed out by water, solvents or CO2 before roasting.

statement.ru: Солдаты Первой мировой пили растворимый кофе.
statement.en: Soldiers in the First World War drank instant coffee.

why: True: US troops drank powdered 'cup of George' instant coffee in the trenches.

statement.ru: В банке колы всего около двух чайных ложек сахара.
statement.en: A can of cola holds only about two teaspoons of sugar.

why: False: a 355 ml can has about 39 g, roughly nine to ten teaspoons.

statement.ru: Пузырьки в газировке — тот же газ, что мы выдыхаем.
statement.en: The bubbles in fizzy drinks are the same gas we breathe out.

why: True: soda is water with dissolved carbon dioxide, the gas we exhale.

statement.ru: Какао и кокос растут на одном и том же дереве.
statement.en: Cocoa and coconuts grow on the same tree.

why: False: coconuts grow on the coconut palm; cocoa comes from the unrelated cacao tree.

statement.ru: Шарики в бабл-ти делают из корня тропического растения.
statement.en: The balls in bubble tea are made from the root of a tropical plant.

why: True: tapioca pearls are made from cassava root starch.

statement.ru: Мате заваривают из листьев того же куста, что и чёрный чай.
statement.en: Mate is brewed from the leaves of the same bush as black tea.

why: False: mate is yerba mate, Ilex paraguariensis, a South American holly.

statement.ru: Бах написал шуточную кантату о любви к кофе.
statement.en: Bach wrote a comic cantata about a love of coffee.

why: True: the Coffee Cantata, about 1732 to 1735, satirises a coffee addiction.

statement.ru: В чайных пакетиках обычно лежат целые чайные листья.
statement.en: Tea bags usually hold whole tea leaves.

why: False: tea bags typically use fannings, the small leftovers after the large leaf is sorted out.

statement.ru: Страховой рынок Lloyd's родился в лондонской кофейне.
statement.en: The insurance market Lloyd's was born in a London coffee house.

why: True: it began in Edward Lloyd's coffee house in the 1680s.

statement.ru: В Тибете чай пьют со сливочным маслом и солью.
statement.en: In Tibet, tea is drunk with butter and salt.

why: True: Tibetan butter tea is made with tea, yak butter, water and salt.

statement.ru: Эспрессо — это особый сорт кофейных зёрен.
statement.en: Espresso is a special variety of coffee bean.

why: False: espresso is a brewing method, hot water forced through fine grounds; any bean can be used.

statement.ru: Чайный куст, если его не стричь, может вырасти выше 10 метров.
statement.en: Left unpruned, a tea bush can grow taller than 10 metres.

why: True: the tea plant grows into a tree if left undisturbed and can reach 20 m; plantations keep it at waist height.

statement.ru: В опыте учёных какао из оранжевой чашки показалось вкуснее, чем из белой.
statement.en: In an experiment, hot chocolate tasted better from an orange cup than a white one.

why: True: a 2012 study (57 tasters) found orange or cream cups improved the chocolate flavour.
